_concept: NORMATIVE MODELS — what 'correct' means, per flow. The AS-DESIGNED reference.
_one_line: Conformance checking is the market's algorithm. The normative content for public-sector finance is ours, and it is where the moat actually is.

_why_this_is_the_most_valuable_asset_cla.the_argument: B4 (declarative conformance) is the heart of the product and is WORTHLESS without a normative model to measure against. We do not compete by building a better conformance checker — pm4py and the market already have one. We compete by being the only ones who know what 'correct' means for budget → commitment → actual.
_why_this_is_the_most_valuable_asset_cla.evidence_of_the_gap: Before this file, exactly ONE normative model existed in the whole system: the 3-way match for P2P. The four public-sector flows — B2C2A, POST2BUDGET, PROJ2FUND, GRANT2REPORT — had none, which is why they are unmined despite carrying the organisation's primary financial control.
_why_this_is_the_most_valuable_asset_cla.portability: A normative model is KIT in its shape and largely KIT in its content: 'no commitment may exceed available budget' is true in every public-sector installation. Only the thresholds and the exception list are tenant-specific.
_why_this_is_the_most_valuable_asset_cla.the_trap: Applying a market normative model without checking the tenant's real shape. A standard O2C model here would report 100% non-conformance because there are ZERO deliveries — a false finding produced by borrowed content.

_anatomy.rules: each rule states a condition that MUST hold, the objects it is evaluated on, and how a violation is quantified
_anatomy.quantification: every violation must be expressible in money or in exposure. A deviation nobody can price is a deviation nobody will fix.
_anatomy.exceptions: legitimate deviations, declared. An undeclared exception is indistinguishable from a violation, and that is how conformance reports lose credibility.

derived_rules.statement: A position commits budget ONLY while it is VACANT. An occupied position generates no commitment of its own — the commitment comes from the PERSON.
derived_rules.mechanism: OTYPE_S with a non-empty HROBJECT_DP is dropped from the requirement set; for OTYPE_P the pointer to the position is cleared
derived_rules.violation_looks_like: a commitment on a position AND on its holder for the same period — double counting. Detect: FMRESERV rows for an S object whose P assignment covers the same interval
derived_rules.checkable_against: FMRESERV x HRP1001 (S-P assignment) over the same period
derived_rules.confidence: read from production source and confirmed line by line
derived_rules.caveat: the comment block says the P->S pointer deletion is 'deactivated' while the code DOES clear it. Comment and code disagree; the code is authoritative

derived_rules.statement: A commitment is PRO-RATED by date intersection with the funding validity window. It is never all-or-nothing at a period boundary.
derived_rules.mechanism: three cases — no overlap SKIPPED; validity contains requirement ADJUSTED whole; partial overlap SPLIT, amount re-derived by ZCL_HRFPM_REQUIREMENT_SERVICES=>ADJUST_COST_DIST_AMOUNT
derived_rules.violation_looks_like: a commitment amount that does not scale with its day range at a validity boundary — a full-period amount on a partial period
derived_rules.checkable_against: FMRESERV amount vs (ENDDA-BEGDA) against the funding window

derived_rules.statement: The relevant biennium BEGINS with the encumbrance interval and ENDS two years from that start. Two invariants are asserted in code: the encumbrance interval MUST end on 31 December, and its span must be at least one year.
derived_rules.mechanism: ASSERT ENDDA+4(4)='1231'; ASSERT year_span GE 1; biennium.BEGDA = enc_iv.BEGDA; biennium.ENDDA(4) = BEGDA(4) + 1

changed_by.was: endda(4) = enc_iv.endda(4) - 1  (one year BEFORE the interval end)
changed_by.now: endda(4) = begda(4) + 1  (two years FROM the start)
changed_by.why_it_matters: the two formulas agree ONLY while the interval is exactly two years. The same transport relaxed the span assertion from BETWEEN 1 AND 2 to GE 1, which permits longer intervals — so the formula had to move with the assertion. One change, two edits.

derived_rules.violation_looks_like: an encumbrance interval not ending 31-12 — the ASSERT dumps, so this surfaces as a short dump rather than a wrong number
derived_rules.checkable_against: T77HRFPM_ENCUMB active interval; ST22 dumps on ASSERT
derived_rules.confidence: read from production source; closes the biennium gap recorded in claim #358

verified.result: active encumbrance variant Y2026 spans 2026-2037 (12 years) but the derived biennium Y2026/27 ends 2027, and FMIOI carries 239,316 lines in 2026, 139,348 in 2027 and ZERO from 2028. The rule read from source and the row count read from production land on the same boundary.
verified.consequence: the biennium is what bounds the money. The 12-year encumbrance interval and the 10-year MV_EXTENSION_YEARS are both UNUSED headroom — R4 is a qualification horizon, R3 is the funding boundary

derived_rules.statement: A temporary position is financed up to MV_EXTENSION_YEARS = 10 years ahead. This is a BUSINESS DECISION LIVING AS A HARD-CODED CONSTANT — the author labelled it 'quasi-config' because the configuration for end-date determination does not exist.

changed_by.why: Spring 2019 change request: temporary positions must be financed to contract end, which may exceed three years

derived_rules.violation_looks_like: nothing visible. The stated reasoning — 'no contract end date will exceed 3 years from today' — has an EXPIRY BUILT IN, and if that assumption stops holding no part of the system will say so. This is the rule most worth re-validating with the business.
derived_rules.checkable_against: PA0001/PA0016 contract end dates vs today + 10 years — count how many exceed the constant

related.statement: temporary positions need to be financed until 'highdate' regardless of business area

verified.result: SAFE TODAY, PREMISE FALSE. 16 real contract end dates exceed today+3y (the premise is refuted); 0 exceed today+10y (the constant holds, ~5 years of headroom, furthest real date 20310831). 1,335 records at HIGHDATE 99991231 are INDEFINITE contracts, not long terms — covered by transport D01K9B050N.
verified.reframing: R4 does NOT limit how far commitments reach — the biennium does (R3, verified). R4 acts earlier, on which posts qualify to be financed.

_reconciliation.authored: P2B-3 — a vacant post does not hold a commitment beyond its declared vacancy tolerance
_reconciliation.derived: PBC-R1 — a post commits ONLY while it is vacant
_reconciliation.finding: these are not the same statement and the difference matters. The authored rule treats a vacant commitment as something to LIMIT; the implementation makes vacancy the very CONDITION for committing. Both can hold — commit while vacant, but not indefinitely — and the tolerance the authored rule assumes is NOT VISIBLE in the code read so far. What bounds it is MV_EXTENSION_YEARS = 10 (PBC-R4), which is a HORIZON, not a tolerance. Whether a vacancy tolerance exists elsewhere is OPEN.
_reconciliation.resolved: RESOLVED s097 (claim 401): the second possibility. The tolerance does not live elsewhere — it is not implemented at all.

B2R._provenance_caution: BBP-04 is UNESCO's AS-DESIGNED intent, NOT the SAP as-shipped baseline. The BCS dimension model, the AVC address triple and PBET are standard SAP CONCEPTS described inside it, and those are legitimately usable as a standard reference. The UNESCO choices around them are not.

rules.as_designed: ONE FM area `UNSC` covers all entities, with company codes distinguishing them. The design calls this a HARD PREREQUISITE and makes consolidated reporting, a unified commitment-item catalog and a single set of derivation rules depend on it.
rules.as_run_measured: NINE FM areas in production: IBE, ICBA, ICTP, IIEP, MGIE, UBO, UIL, UIS, UNES — measured in both fmioi.BUKRS and fmavct_2026.RFIKRS. That is the 2017 AS-IS list itself, minus IESALC and IITE.
rules.why_it_is_the_biggest_one: everything else in BBP-04 was designed ON TOP of the consolidation. A unified commitment-item catalog and a single derivation strategy are not partially achievable across nine FM areas — so a large part of the design is not 'pending', it is unreachable in the current structure.
rules.consequence_today: every consolidated budget answer requires manual reconciliation across nine areas, which is precisely the AS-IS problem the design was written to remove

rules.as_designed: BCS controls on SEVEN dimensions: Fund, Budget Period, Grant, Funds Center, Commitment Item, Funded Program, Functional Area. Fund means the FUNDING SOURCE and explicitly NOT the project — the design flags this as a reversal of the AS-IS meaning.
rules.as_run_measured: dimension 3 (Grant) requires GM, and GM has ZERO tables in the golden and is NOT_USED in the profile. Six dimensions at most. Separately, our own model still carries `PROJ.PSPID = GEBER` as a STATIC PROXY for fund — i.e. project-as-fund, the very equivalence the design set out to reverse.

rules.as_designed: AVC distinguishes THREE addresses: POSTING (the full FM assignment on the transaction), BUDGET (where budget is entered, possibly at a higher aggregation) and CONTROL (where the check fires, which can differ from both). The design's own example: budget at Fund + Funds Center + Budget Period, control at Fund + Funds Center + Commitment Item GROUP + Budget Period.
rules.as_run_measured: the control record is keyed Fund x Fund Center x GROUPED commitment item, ledger 9H — which matches the design's control-address example closely. Tolerance profiles Z000/Z001/Z002/ZIT1/ZIT2/ZIT3/Z100/Z200 with Error / Warning / Information semantics, as designed.
rules.why_this_one_matters_most: this is the vocabulary our own avc_availability_model.md lacked. We measured the control address correctly and had no NAME for the distinction between posting, budget and control — which is exactly what a standard reference is for. It also explains why a hand-rolled `available = budget - commitment - actual` is refuted: that formula assumes posting address equals control address, and here it does not.

rules.as_designed: FMDERIVE populates the FM assignment automatically from FI/CO data. The design states users do NOT manually enter FM account assignment, and calls this essential for user acceptance. Cost Center to Funds Center and GL Account to Commitment Item are declared 1:1.
rules.as_run_measured: FMDT_FIELD and FMDT_STEP DO NOT EXIST on ECC 6.0 EhP8 — derivation lives in the generic derivation tool TABADR*. Strategy FMOA carries 14 step rows, the year-change FMYC 22. And the FI leg is set by the ABAP user exit ZXFMDTU02_RPY, not by a table-driven strategy.
rules.nuance: the OUTCOME the design wanted — automatic derivation, no manual FM entry — appears to hold. The MECHANISM is different from the one designed and documented. That distinction matters: the user experience conforms, the maintainability does not, because a user exit is code and a strategy is configuration.
rules.checkable_against: TABADR* strategies FMOA/FMYC/EAHR; the ZXFMDTU02_RPY source

rules.as_designed: the canonical SAP coding block: ONE posting simultaneously populates FI, CO, FM and GM. GL Account / Cost Element / Commitment Item / Sponsored Class are the same category across modules; Fund and Grant are SHARED fields present in all four; Funds Center is shared FM-GM; Functional Area spans all four; Funded Program is the FM object whose GM parallel is Sponsored Program.
rules.as_run_measured: MEASURED over 2,308,814 FM line items in fmifiit_full: Fund (FONDS) 100% · Funds Center (FISTL) 100% · Commitment Item (FIPEX) 100% — and then FOUR EMPTY: Funded Program (MEASURE) 0.0%, Functional Area (FAREA) 0.0% with the single distinct value being blank, Grant 0% (GM has zero tables), Budget Period column absent entirely.
rules.the_finding: the 'seven-dimensional BCS' runs as a THREE-dimensional budget control. Not a shortfall at the margin: four of seven dimensions carry no value in a single row out of 2.3 million.

what_each_empty_dimension_costs.Functional Area: BBP-04 defines it as UNESCO's C/5 EXPECTED RESULTS — the programme structure, used for STATUTORY REPORTING BY PROGRAMME OBJECTIVE. Empty means budget consumption cannot be reported by programme objective from FM at all. For an organisation whose entire mandate is expressed as C/5 Expected Results, this is the dimension that connects money to purpose, and it is unused.
what_each_empty_dimension_costs.Funded Program: the designed WBS-to-FM bridge — 'maps WBS elements from PS into the FM world'. Empty. THIS EXPLAINS SOMETHING WE HAD ONLY OBSERVED: our own bridge still uses PROJ.PSPID = GEBER, project-as-fund, and both projects call it a static proxy without saying why it survives. It survives BECAUSE the designed bridge dimension carries nothing — the fund code IS the only project link there is.
what_each_empty_dimension_costs.Grant: GM is NOT_USED; consistent with S2, not an independent finding
what_each_empty_dimension_costs.Budget Period: the column is absent, so biennium control is not carried on the line item

rules.kind: AS_DESIGNED — and it is a DELETION, which makes it the sharpest rule here
rules.as_designed: BBP-08 calls this 'the most significant simplification': the practice of using a special CONSTANT EXCHANGE RATE for EUR-to-USD conversion IN BUDGET EXECUTION is ELIMINATED. Constant dollar becomes strictly a REPORTING concept — an extra column in BW that converts EUR transactions at the constant rate. Budget control instead uses an additional AVC in BCS with a tolerance (the design cites ~105%), RATHER THAN MANIPULATING POSTING EXCHANGE RATES. The stated reason is IPSAS: postings must use operational rates.
rules.as_run_measured: the opposite was built. YCL_FM_BR_EXCHANGE_RATE_BL is a custom class that MANIPULATES the exchange rate during budget execution — precisely the mechanism the design removed. And it carries a one-line defect confirmed in production source: `APPEND VALUE #( sign='I' option='EQ' low='EUR' ) TO mr_waers` means the conversion gate only opens for EUR, so a USD posting exits via CHECK without setting rv_is_ok and the Budget Rate conversion is SKIPPED SILENTLY. A trace showed 42 invocations of the class and ZERO reads of TCURR — it fired and converted nothing.
rules.verdict: DEVIATES — THE DESIGN DELETED THIS MECHANISM AND IT WAS BUILT ANYWAY
rules.why_this_reframes_the_incident: INC-BUDGETRATE-EQG reads as 'a bug to fix' without the as-designed reference. With it, it reads as: a mechanism the blueprint explicitly eliminated was implemented, and its failure mode is the very reason it was eliminated. The design's alternative — an AVC tolerance in BCS — would not have this failure class at all, because it never touches the posting rate. This is the clearest demonstration in the project of why S_STANDARD_REF matters: the same facts, a completely different conclusion.

measured_blast_radius.source: P01 golden scan of fmioi + fmifiit_full, session 054

rules.violation_looks_like: FMAVC005 on a fund that appears to have budget: a USD posting consumes an EUR-loaded reservation without the Budget Rate conversion, so the two ledgers drift by the rate gap and the pool reads as exhausted when it is not
rules.checkable_against: fmioi/fmifiit_full — funds carrying EUR-loaded FRs with USD consumption; and extracted_code/CLAS/YCL_FM_BR_EXCHANGE_RATE_BL/CM00A for the gate itself
rules.the_workaround_is_unsustainable: 'post in EUR' is the current functional workaround, and operational reality forces USD postings — vendor invoices, travel. So the drift keeps accruing on 458 funds until the gate is fixed or the mechanism is retired in favour of what BBP-08 specified.
rules.note_on_ipsas: the design's reason for the deletion was IPSAS compliance — postings must use operational exchange rates. A mechanism that overrides the posting rate is therefore not only fragile, it is at odds with the standard the design was aligning to. That is a question for the business, not a technical one.

It covers FIT (funds-in-trust), Special Accounts, Additional Appropriations and Framework Agreements, plus a multi-funding process for EU agreements with percentage-based allocation, and EUR grant handling for UIL and ICTP.

rules.as_run_measured: every element of that AS-IS description is still measurable today. GM: zero tables. The 'misused Fund object': PROJ.PSPID = GEBER, project-as-fund, still the only project link and labelled a STATIC PROXY in both this project and the peer one. The 'misused WBS object': Funded Program, the designed WBS-to-FM bridge dimension, is populated in 0.0% of 2,308,814 FM line items.
rules.verdict: NOT_IMPLEMENTED — the described problem is the current state
rules.why_this_is_the_finding: three separate measurements converge on one statement. BBP-04 insisted that Fund means the FUNDING SOURCE and explicitly NOT the project, calling the reversal a design principle. BBP-06 named the misuse of Fund and WBS as the problem to solve. And the data shows the misuse intact and the replacement dimension empty. NINE YEARS ON, THE AS-IS OF THE BLUEPRINT IS THE AS-RUN OF THE SYSTEM on this axis. That is not a gap in the model — it is the finding the model exists to produce.

rules.as_designed: AS-IS, projects and WBS elements reflected DONOR requirements: several projects could represent parts of one real project, and only externally-funded costs were included, so Regular-Budget costs sat outside the project structure and could not be monitored alongside extra-budgetary ones. TO-BE, by introducing GM for donor-centred reporting, the project and WBS are FREED to give an internal, controlling-driven view: one project with multiple funding sources, RP and XB costs visible in one structure, project creation moving from BFM to project managers, and projects created earlier so data on rejected projects also exists.
rules.as_run_measured: the freeing DEPENDS ENTIRELY on GM carrying the donor view, and GM has zero tables. So the project structure was never freed: it still carries what the donor view was meant to take over. Consistent with Funded Program at 0.0% and PROJ.PSPID = GEBER.

rules.kind: AS_DESIGNED — PBC, the counterpart of what we read from production source
rules.as_designed: four PBC developments: (1) update the encumbrance-filter BAdI Z_UNESCO_ENCUMB_FIL for the new master data; (2) RECONFIGURE the financing-horizon rules in the new structure; (3) align Personnel Cost Simulation with the new dimensions; (4) update vacancy-termination budget release. The BAdI rework is stated to require three things: the 1:1 commitment-item structure, the Fund object meaning funding source rather than project, and the UNIFIED FM AREA.
rules.as_run_measured: ALL THREE PRECONDITIONS ARE UNMET — 18 coarse commitment items, project-as-fund still the proxy, and nine FM areas. And the developments themselves, measured against the production source we read: (2) financing horizon was designed as RECONFIGURATION and built as a HARD-CODED CONSTANT — MV_EXTENSION_YEARS = 10, with the author's own comment 'until a configuration for the enddate determination rules is available, use hard-coded values'. The configuration the design called for does not exist. (4) vacancy-termination release: no vacancy TOLERANCE exists in the code at all — the vacancy filter is binary and DO_HANDLE_COMMITMENT_PERIOD is literally ASSERT 1 = 2. (1) the filter class ZCL_IM__UNESCO_ENCUMB_FILTER is TWENTY-FIVE LINES.
rules.verdict: DEVIATES — designed as configuration, built as constants
rules.why_this_is_the_pattern_not_the_exceptio: the same shape appears three times in this ingest: a rule designed to live in configuration, delivered as a literal in code. MV_EXTENSION_YEARS, the constant-rate mechanism, the 001-099 reporting range. Each one is invisible to every configuration analysis, and each one is why algorithm A9 exists.

B2R._headline: the design's own HARD PREREQUISITE — consolidating nine FM areas into one — was never implemented, and nine years later production still runs the 2017 AS-IS structure. Everything else in BBP-04 was designed on top of it. || AND THE SECOND PASS IS WORSE: measured against the standard coding block, the seven-dimensional BCS runs as THREE dimensions. Fund, Funds Center and Commitment Item are 100% populated across 2,308,814 FM line items; Funded Program, Functional Area, Grant and Budget Period carry nothing. Functional Area is UNESCO's C/5 Expected Results — the dimension that ties money to programme purpose — and it is blank in every single row. || AND THE SHARPEST RULE IS A DELETION: BBP-08 eliminated the constant exchange rate from budget execution, making it a REPORTING concept and specifying an AVC tolerance instead, expressly to stay IPSAS-aligned. A custom class that manipulates the posting rate was built anyway, and its one-line gate defect has a measured blast radius of 458 funds, 135,792 bypass postings and ~$35.7M of AVC drift exposure. || AND THE THIRD PASS CLOSES A CIRCLE: BBP-06, the programme's most comprehensive blueprint, designed GM as a first-class module with five dimensions and a seven-stage lifecycle. ZERO gm* tables exist. More than that, the AS-IS it set out to replace — 'donor agreements tracked outside SAP, with only indirect representation through MISUSED Fund and WBS master data objects' — is measurably the state today: Funded Program 0.0%, PROJ.PSPID = GEBER still the only project link. _the_synthesis._one_sentence: THREE FOUNDATIONS WERE DESIGNED AND NONE WAS BUILT, and almost every other design in the blueprint stands on them.

the_three.unified FM area: one area UNSC — production runs NINE
the_three.Fund means funding source, not project: PROJ.PSPID = GEBER is still the only project link

what_stood_on_them: a unified commitment-item catalogue and a single derivation strategy (BBP-04) — both require the single FM area
projects freed from donor requirements (BBP-07) — requires GM to take the donor view
the PBC encumbrance-filter rework (BBP-10) — requires all three at once
the seven-dimensional BCS — runs as three, with Functional Area and Funded Program empty in 2.3 million rows
_the_synthesis._why_this_matters_more_than_any_single_r: these are not fourteen independent gaps. They are three unbuilt foundations and eleven consequences. A remediation plan that treats them as a list will fund eleven efforts that cannot succeed; one that treats them as a tree has three decisions to make, and they are governance decisions rather than technical ones.
_the_synthesis._and_the_recurring_shape: separately, three times over: a rule the design placed in CONFIGURATION was delivered as a LITERAL IN CODE — the financing horizon, the constant exchange rate, the reporting fund-type range. No configuration analysis can see any of them, which is the entire reason algorithm A9 exists.
_the_synthesis._SUPERSEDED_BY_THE_AS_RUN: the 'three unbuilt foundations' framing holds as archaeology and dissolves as a plan. The three — unified FM area, fund-as-source, GM as donor view — were not abandoned by neglect: the organisation built a different architecture in front of SAP that delivers the same outcomes through integration. GM was never needed because donor management lives in Salesforce and SISTER. The WBS-to-FM link does not need Funded Program because MuleSoft INT-01 maintains PROJ and PRPS directly. The one that may still be a genuine structural cost is the NINE FM AREAS, and even that has to be judged against how consolidated reporting is actually produced today rather than against the blueprint.

_READ_THIS_BEFORE_THE_RULES._the_correction: The 17 rules below measure production against the 2017 BLUEPRINTS. The deltas are real — nine FM areas, zero GM tables, 18 commitment items, Functional Area and Funded Program empty in 2.3M rows — but THE FRAME WAS WRONG. Measuring against a design that was superseded turns 'the system works differently' into 'the system failed', and those are not the same claim.
_READ_THIS_BEFORE_THE_RULES._what_actually_happened: UNESCO kept SAP as the SYSTEM OF RECORD and moved the SYSTEM OF ENGAGEMENT entirely outside it — Salesforce/Core Planner, ORION, named-user portals. Not around SAP: IN FRONT OF it. That is a deliberate architecture, measured from both ends: the Salesforce event log (23,730 status events, 26,075 posting events) and the SAP audit log (15.6M RFC calls) describe the same model independently.
_READ_THIS_BEFORE_THE_RULES._the_warning_their_own_work_already_carr: knowledge/36 re-scored one of its own claims with exactly this diagnosis: the 'manual entry' reading of FC/CC/FA was 'A DESIGN-DOC ARTIFACT OVERTAKEN BY THE AS-RUN'. And it deprecates any dialog-based baseline outright: 'a redesign baselined on dialog usage is baselined on <20% of the real traffic.' I walked into the failure mode their document names.
_READ_THIS_BEFORE_THE_RULES._how_each_rule_must_now_be_read: as AS-DESIGNED-SUPERSEDED, not as a conformance target. A NOT_IMPLEMENTED verdict below means 'the blueprint specified this and the organisation built something else' — which is a finding about the DESIGN's relevance, not about the system's health. The rules keep their value as archaeology and as vocabulary (the AVC address triple named something we had measured and could not name); they lose it as a scorecard.

_the_real_b2r_yardstick._what_it_says: the cross-system handoff is NOT the bottleneck — the seam is near-instant at 1.8 days median. The time lives upstream in HUMAN VALIDATION at ~21 days median and 428 at p90. So the leverage in B2R is human throughput, not integration and not SAP configuration.
_the_real_b2r_yardstick._and_the_failure_modes_are_named: the forward sync is SERIAL and STOP-ON-FIRST-ERROR, so one failing object halts a whole workplan. 103 workplans and 354 allocations carry errors, attributed: fund create/assign ~130 (the top single error being 'Assignment to 43 C/5 not possible with fund validity 01.01.2024-31.12.2025', 39 times), project create ~67.
_the_real_b2r_yardstick._the_named_operational_gap: INT-05, Fund Center master SAP->Core Planner, BLOCKED since 2023
